verdict.rationale: Activepieces is open-source and self-hostable, and lets users 'bring your own AI keys' and 'run it on your own infrastructure,' which implicitly limits data flowing to a third-party AI trainer, but there is no explicit policy statement or setting about preventing AI-model training on user data. missing for 10: an explicit no-training-on-data policy or opt-out setting, terms-of-service language addressing model training, and independent confirmation of this privacy posture.
